verdict.rationale: Devin Review runs automated first-pass reviews on pull requests, checking correctness and conformance with org best practices. Auto-Fix responds to review comments and iterates on CI failures, and Devin can act on static-analysis findings (SonarQube, Fortify, Veracode) in CI/CD, so the pre-merge checking core is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a developer-facing diff inspection view (only an embedded IDE to follow and take over is mentioned), detail on how checks are run or configured, and independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
